# Design System (AI SaaS Agent)

> Extreme-minimal design system for AI agent products, for Vue 3 + Vuetify 3.11.
> Geist-inspired: no shadows, 1px borders, radius 2/4/6px, Pretendard font,
> brand blue #1F7FF0 (light) / #4593F5 (dark), Radix Slate gray 1-12.
> Light + dark via [data-theme="dark"]. Docs: https://kimjiyong995-coder.github.io/design-system/

## Two kinds of components — DO NOT MIX THE IMPORTS

1. STANDALONE (20) — no Vuetify needed. Needs ds.css only.
   import { DsButton, ... } from '~/design'
   Button, Input, Badge, Chip, Avatar, Card, Divider, Skeleton, Toast, EmptyState,
   ChatMessage, StreamingText, ThinkingIndicator, ToolCallStep, AgentInput,
   CitationChip, ArtifactPanel, SearchResult, FileGrid, FileRow

2. VUETIFY-BASED (29) — wraps a Vuetify component. Needs ds.css + ds-vuetify.css.
   import { DsDataTable, ... } from '~/design/vuetify'
   Action:   DsIconButton(VBtn), DsButtonGroup(VBtnToggle), DsMenu(VMenu)
   Nav:      DsTabs, DsBreadcrumbs, DsPagination, DsNavList(VList), DsStepper
   Input:    DsSelect, DsAutocomplete, DsTextarea, DsCheckbox, DsRadioGroup,
             DsSwitch, DsSlider, DsFileInput, DsDatePicker
   Feedback: DsAlert, DsBanner, DsProgressBar, DsSpinner, DsSnackbar
   Overlay:  DsDialog, DsTooltip
   Data:     DsDataTable, DsList, DsTreeview, DsTimeline, DsAccordion

Rule for choosing: behavior that is hard to rebuild (focus trap, positioning,
scroll lock, keyboard nav, sorting/pagination) stays Vuetify. Purely visual
components and agent-specific ones are built from scratch.

## Rules for AI code generation
- Use ONLY CSS variables (var(--gray-3), var(--brand)). Never hardcode hex.
- Gray roles: 1-2 bg, 3-5 hover/disabled, 6-8 borders, 9-11 secondary text, 12 body.
- Brand color only for actions, selection, focus, links. Backgrounds stay neutral.
- No box-shadow except floating elements (Toast, Menu, Dialog).
- One primary button per screen.
- Async surfaces show PROGRESS (ToolCallStep/ThinkingIndicator), not a bare spinner.
- Every component handles: default, loading, empty, error.
- Component names English; UI copy may be Korean.

## Files
ds.css              tokens + standalone component styles (single source of truth)
ds-vuetify.css      restyles for the 5 Vuetify-based components
vue/index.ts        barrel — standalone components (no Vuetify import)
vue/vuetify.ts      barrel — Vuetify-based components
vue/meta.ts         origin + reason (en/ko) per component
vue/defaults.ts     Vuetify defaults (VMenu/VDialog/VDataTable...) — enforcement layer
data.js             component registry powering the docs site
templates/          golden screens: chat.html, search.html

## Installation
No npm install. Copy ds.css, ds-vuetify.css and vue/ into app/src/design/,
register the CSS in nuxt.config, optionally wire dsDefaults into createVuetify.
Vuetify stays at 3.11 — no migration, existing screens unchanged.

## Compatibility (verified 2026-07-31)
Verified inside a real Vuetify 3.11.6 app — see examples/vuetify-app.
vite build passes (602 modules, 0 errors); all 25 components render inside <v-app>.
"Standalone" means "does not REQUIRE Vuetify" — it still works perfectly inside a
Vuetify app, and is unaffected by Vuetify version changes.
Isolation guarantees: 0 vuetify imports in standalone components, 0 !important in
ds.css, 0 .v-* class definitions in ds.css, all:unset on every component root.

## Vuetify coverage — ALL 96 Vuetify 3.11 components are styled
Do NOT wrap every Vuetify component. Coverage works in three layers:
1. vue/theme.ts    — injects our tokens into Vuetify's theme (colors). Applies to ALL components.
2. vue/defaults.ts — per-component defaults for 77 components (elevation 0, outlined, rounded md,
                     ripple off, density comfortable). <v-alert> etc. need no extra setup.
3. ds-vuetify.css  — font, radius, border weight that the theme system cannot control.
Only 5 components are wrapped as Ds* (DataTable, Dialog, Menu, Tooltip, Select) because their
API benefits from simplification. Everything else is used as plain <v-*> and still looks correct.

Setup: createVuetify({ theme: dsTheme, defaults: dsDefaults }) + load ds.css and ds-vuetify.css.

## Example app
examples/vuetify-app — an Audit Log screen (table-centric) on real Vuetify 3.11.6.
Covers: DataTable with cell slots, filters, density switch, row menu, detail dialog,
loading/empty states, toast, agent analysis panel, and a section of raw <v-*> components
proving theme+defaults alone produce our styling.

## Choosing between similar components
Checkbox vs Switch  — Switch = instant apply; Checkbox = needs a save button.
Alert vs Snackbar   — Alert persists on screen; Snackbar appears and disappears.
Alert vs Banner     — Alert is regional; Banner is page-wide.
Spinner vs Thinking — Spinner for <2s waits; agent work always uses ThinkingIndicator
                      or ToolCallStep (Principle 1: show progress, not a bare spinner).
Select vs Autocomplete — >10 options means Autocomplete.
DataTable vs List   — fixed columns + sorting means DataTable; otherwise List.
Badge vs Chip       — Badge is read-only; Chip is removable.
ProgressBar         — only when the percentage is known; otherwise ThinkingIndicator.

## Live gallery
examples/vuetify-app renders every component on real Vuetify 3.11.6:
  #        → component gallery (each entry states WHY it exists and WHERE to use it)
  #audit   → audit log screen (table, filters, dialog, loading/empty states)

## Foundation (docs site: #/foundation/*)
Decisions made before components. 14 pages, modeled on seed-design.io (Karrot) and
atlassian.design, with density/grid from IBM Carbon and writing from Shopify Polaris.

overview, tokens, color, typography, spacing, shape (radius+border), elevation,
density, iconography, motion, state, a11y, writing, i18n

Key foundation rules an AI must follow when generating screens:
- Color: brand ONLY for actions/selection/focus/links. Gray does 95% of the work.
  Gray roles: 1-2 bg, 3 hover, 4-5 soft border, 6 default border, 8 hover border,
  9 faint text, 11 secondary text, 12 body text.
- Type: Pretendard, 5 sizes (12/13/14/16/20), weights 400/500/600 only (never 700+).
  Hierarchy comes from weight and color, not size. No uppercase (breaks Korean).
  No positive letter-spacing. word-break: keep-all.
- Spacing: 4px multiples only (0,4,8,12,16,24,32,48,64). Grouping = proximity.
  Reading width max 720px; data screens 1080-1280px.
- Shape: radius 2/4/6/full. Border always 1px. Nested radius <= parent radius.
- Elevation: NO elevation scale. Shadow only on Menu/Dialog/Tooltip/Snackbar.
- Density: compact 32px / comfortable 40px (default) / spacious 48px row heights.
  Never mix densities within one screen.
- Motion: 120ms default, 240ms max, ease only, fade only for overlays, no ripple.
  Respect prefers-reduced-motion.
- State: every list/table needs default, loading, empty, error, partial.
  Every interactive element needs hover, focus-visible, active, disabled, selected.
  Never remove focus outline.
- A11y: WCAG 2.2 AA. Never rely on color alone. aria-label on icon-only buttons.
- Writing: errors never apologize. Formula = what happened + why + what you can do.
  Buttons start with a verb; dialog buttons repeat the action ("Delete", not "OK").

## Icons — Lucide (registered, applied)
The ONLY external dependency: `lucide-vue-next` (ISC). 2px stroke.

  import { DsIcon } from '~/design/icon'
  <DsIcon name="delete" />            <!-- semantic name, NOT the Lucide name -->
  <DsIcon name="agent" size="lg" />   <!-- sm=16 md=20 lg=24 only -->
  <DsIcon name="loading" spin />
  <DsIcon name="search" label="검색" /> <!-- label required if meaningful -->

Icons are addressed by MEANING, not by Lucide's name (delete, not Trash2; agent,
not Bot). The registry lives in vue/icons.ts — add new icons there with a semantic
name. Never import from 'lucide-vue-next' directly in a screen.

Registered vocabulary (59): search filter close add confirm copy download upload
delete edit more refresh settings view archive send attach command externalLink
link | expand collapse prev back forward | folder folderOpen file document
spreadsheet drive | agent ai run chat citation artifact source | gridView listView
tableView calendar time notification | user team permission permissionDenied lock
signOut | error warning success info loading | play pause light dark

Components that display icons (DsFileRow, DsFileGrid, DsNavList, DsList, DsBanner)
take them through an `#icon` SLOT, so standalone components stay dependency-free:
  <DsFileRow name="x.pdf"><template #icon><DsIcon name="document" size="sm" /></template></DsFileRow>

Rules: icon color = currentColor (same as adjacent text; never brand-only).
Sizes 16/20/24 only. aria-label on icon-only buttons. One set — never mix.
